sermon.title: God’s Promises to All the Acceptable 11/12/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God has promises for “the acceptable”—those like Cornelius who fear God and do right by conscience: the Spirit poured on all flesh, the earth filled with his glory, transformation into Christ’s image, knowing God, and wisdom from above. From Acts 19 he asks whether believers have received the Holy Ghost, urges adding virtue to faith, and teaches that any believer can lay on hands.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The man who prayed for the pastor is named in the transcript only. Sensitive content kept as spoken: people in heaven who never heard Christ’s name; Cornelius’s household filled “and they weren't even believers”; rejecting the baptism of the Holy Ghost “ridiculous”; “there's no rapture coming in their generation”; Baptist, Assembly of God and Copeland’s doctrine; feminists and TV shows that “put men down”; women in the church.

chunks.section_question: Can ordinary members lay on hands?
chunks.short_answer: Yes—a church member prayed for him and the Holy Ghost welled up. It’s the principle, not the big name; you can impart a blessing.
chunks.text:
Hallelujah. he laid hands on them three Sundays ago I was sick I came into the church and as people do John asked me how you doing I said I’m a little under the weather remember John he said well I’m [unclear] pray for you I’m not afraid to pray for you I’m a [unclear] man I’ll pray for you and he put his hand on me and started praying and the minute he put his hand on me started praying the Holy Ghost welled up within me I spoke in tongues to myself because it was a self edifying experience nobody needed to hear it and John didn’t even know he just prayed for me and John is no Moses he’s no Paul he’s just a member of the church that obeyed a principle and God come and ignited me. Laying on of hands is a Bible principle.

And. don’t think you got to be Mr. Mrs. Perfect. To operate the principle and God will use it if you wait for your perfection day it’s gonna be a while it may it may not even come in your lifetime. faqs.question: Who is acceptable?
faqs.answer: Those who fear God and do right by conscience.

faqs.question: On whom will the Spirit be poured?
Who shall know God in the new covenant?
To whom does God give wisdom?
What did Paul ask the Ephesians?
faqs.answer: Have you received the Holy Ghost?

faqs.question: What do we add to faith?
faqs.answer: Virtue, knowledge, self-control, patience, godliness, kindness, love.
